Cordis plugin: registers a consumer of `sessionPersistence` whose cleanup effect is released only after the persistence provider's fiber disposes; throws 'Persistence did not await its consumer cleanup' if the provider finished first, then appends a `todo/write` event so the consumer's final event is the last persisted line.

V4 transcript proving the ordering: `turn/end` is written, THEN a `todo/write` event lands as the final persisted line, i.e. the consumer's cleanup event survived the provider-only unload.
Manifest: default composition, authored recording, header class `default` with no prompt/schema pin.
